[IRET.6.5] **Alpha memory.** The memory is a hash set
keyed by `fact->id`. Insert and remove are O(1) average.
The set supports iteration (for beta network left-memory
join on fresh right memory).

idris.name: iret_6_5__insert
idris.note: Insert: append to the memory. The clause's hash set is a list in working-memory order; the view fixes its content.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view
idris.note: What the memory must hold: the facts of the schema passing the tests, in working-memory order.

idris.name: iret_6_5__dummy_view
idris.note: The dangling node shows nothing under any working memory.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_append_hit
idris.note: A fact the node admits, appended to working memory, is appended to the view.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_append_miss
idris.note: A fact the node does not admit, appended to working memory, leaves the view.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_insert
idris.note: Inserting a fact leaves the node's schema and tests, so its view.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_remove
idris.note: Removing a fact leaves the node's schema and tests, so its view.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_retract
idris.note: The view of working memory less a fact is the view less the fact.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_retract_miss
idris.note: Retracting a fact the node does not admit leaves the view.

idris.name: Iret_6_5__mems_live
idris.note: Every alpha memory holds live facts only.

idris.name: iret_6_5__view_live
idris.note: A fact of a node's view is a fact of the working memory viewed.

idris.name: iret_6_5__insert_same_alphas
idris.note: Inserting a fact into one alpha memory keeps the shape.

idris.name: iret_6_5__remove_same_alphas
idris.note: Removing a fact from one alpha memory keeps the shape.

idris.name: iret_6_5__set_at_none
idris.note: Updating an index past the list changes nothing.
